_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your own values. config.json is gitignored.

notion._comment:
Run this once with curl to find IDs:
  curl 'https://api.notion.com/v1/search' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_TOKEN>' \
    -H 'Notion-Version: 2026-03-11' \
    -d '{"query": "<page or database title>"}'
  Then read the 'id' field from the response.

fields._comment: 标准字段 -> 你的库里的实际列名，由 birding-setup 自动生成，一般不需要手改
fields.name: 中文名

notion.life_list_database_id: <UUID of your bird life-list database, e.g. 37871355-4c9a-8073-b4a3-000b9cc2ea18>
notion.orders_database_id: <UUID of your bird Orders catalog database (optional)>
notion.nature_root_page_id: <UUID of root '🌳 自然' page (optional, used as fallback parent)>

xenocanto._comment: Get a free API key at https://xeno-canto.org/account

user_preferences._comment: 示例值，实际由 birding-setup 询问用户后生成。
user_preferences.primary_location: <你常观鸟的城市，如 广州>
user_preferences.image_inclusion_policy: （可选）如：信息增量原则；古画/解剖/系统树优先；普通生态摄影不放
